why:
The same procedure as desk-booking against a different topic, run after the boundary fix and never seen while writing it. One candidate: a lone `git log -1 --stat` follows the commit and work after the last commit keeps its own boundary, but it is one step, so it is dropped as too thin and never banked.

This said 2 until the scorer was corrected. It was counting cut episodes, which is the first of three stages, while stating in this very sentence that only one is banked — and the scorer made the matching mistake, so the two errors cancelled and it passed.
history: Banked 5 fragments before the fix, and its commit was invisible to marker detection: the agent used `git -C <path> commit`, which normalised to a bare `git`.
